svg.title: Phase lag of a marble
svg.desc: Raw, smoothed and eased CPU use for a step workload, and the difference between the cumulative CPU time and the marble's angle.
svg.text: raw CPU of each 1 s interval (steps)
model smoothing, tau 1.5 s (dots, per sample)
scene easing, tau 0.3 s (line, per frame)
Cumulative CPU time minus the marble's angle, in CPU-seconds
One lap is 10 CPU-seconds, so 1 CPU-second of lag is 0.1 lap. The lag follows the current CPU level and returns to zero when the process idles;
it never accumulates, because the filters conserve area. The marble is re-seated at 2 pi cpu_time / LAP whenever it is created again.
